features.ip_note: Proxy modes basic / enhanced / auto (enhanced costs the same 1 credit), country via location.country (default US); IP types not disclosed; no fixed outbound IPs (dedicated static egress is enterprise).

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.
Docs distinguish 2 credit code sessions from 7 credit prompt sessions; pricing table omits prompt premium. Never assume 2 credit rate for all agents.
Page-render concurrency (2/5/25/50/100) is published; browser-sandbox per-endpoint admission may differ. Sessions default TTL 10 min, max 60 min; idle TTL 5 min.

Pay-as-you-go increments are $5, so engine smooth-rate estimate needs upward rounding. Plan credits reset monthly even under annual commitment. Rollover docs narrow it to annual Scale 1 month/Enterprise 2 months whereas pricing table omits annual condition.
Source pricing rendered in EUR by geolocation; canonical pricing.md gives binding USD and yearly totals. Use annual totals rather than rounded $16/$83/$333/$599 headlines.

Start-rate limits for browser sandbox sessions (POST /interact per minute): Free 2, Hobby 20, Standard 100, Growth 1,000, Scale 1,500; /interact/{id}/execute 10/100/500/5,000/7,500 per minute. Exceeding the concurrent-browser limit returns 429 for new sessions (no queue).

Pay-as-you-go: credits are added in $5 increments until a monthly limit. A blank limit means no cap, and a limit of 0 means a hard 402 stop. While PAYG is on, an overage headroom of 1,500 / 30,000 / 150,000 / 600,000 credits (Hobby/Standard/Growth/Scale) lets bursts run while top-ups settle. Upgrades charge the full new-plan price immediately (no proration) and reset the cycle. Unused plan credits carry over on upgrade.

Free plan: 1,000 credits/month = 500 code-only browser minutes (8.3 h) or ~143 prompted minutes (2.4 h), hard HTTP 402 at zero, no PAYG. The card's Free plan has sizes_allowed [] and included_usd 0, so the engine can never pick Free even for tiny workloads that fit.

fleet.verification: Free no card; paid-plan checkout and card-on-file for pay-as-you-go credit refills.
fleet.tiers: Free 2; Hobby 5; Standard 25; Growth 50; Scale 100; Enterprise custom.
fleet.notes: Processing/browser concurrency shared by jobs; excess work queues. Upgrades apply immediately according to billing docs. 10 fits Standard, 50 Growth, 300/1,000 Enterprise. API rate limits and credit budgets also apply.
